The second overcounts first-round games and also miscalculates its written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02623","case1_error":"Subtracts car spending from console price instead of subtracting remaining savings, ignoring the $620 earned when calculating the shortfall.","case2_error":"Provides correct earnings formulas followed by unsupported numerical outputs ending in 1020; the formulas yield 840.","reason":"The first uses an incorrect financial relation; the second supplies incorrect numbers without showing a corresponding erroneous relation or numerical evaluation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02624","case1_error":"Gives unsupported total 120 after calculating only Nikki’s and Ryn’s durations; never derives Michael’s, Joyce’s, or their combined total.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correct expression 200−60−56 as 184 instead of 84, inflating the final total.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported final total from incomplete work; the second visibly miscalculates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"}]}
